desc:
Small pieces get lost and tangled fast. This velvet pouch opens wide to six inner pockets, so each piece has its own place. It is about 5.5 × 4.3 in, light, and closes with a wrap-around zipper and tassel pull. Two pouches per pack.

Specifications:
- Size: about 14 × 11 cm (5.5 × 4.3 in)
- Outside: velvet; inside: smooth lining with 6 layered pockets
- Closure: wrap-around zipper with tassel pull
- Quantity: 2 pouches
- Colors: peacock blue and olive green (1 each)
b: 6 INNER POCKETS — Open the zipper and the pouch fans out like a little book, with six layered pockets to keep rings, earrings, bracelets and necklaces apart.
POCKET SIZE — About 5.5 × 4.3 in (14 × 11 cm). Slips into a handbag, carry-on or drawer.
SOFT VELVET OUTSIDE — A soft-touch velvet shell with a smooth lining inside the pouch.
WRAP-AROUND ZIPPER AND TASSEL — The zipper runs around the edge so the pouch opens wide, and the tassel pull is easy to grab.
2 POUCHES PER PACK — One peacock blue and one olive green. Keep one at home and one in your travel bag, or give one as a small gift.
kw: small jewelry pouch travel jewelry case mini jewelry organizer bag velvet jewelry bag zipper ring earring holder travel bracelet storage gift for women
